card.name: Large integer sets with no two-other-product divisibility

task.name: Large integer sets with no two-other-product divisibility
task.description: construct() -> nonempty distinct integers in 2..256. For every THREE DISTINCT members a,b,c, require that a does not divide b*c. Maximize cardinality. In particular b and c cannot denote the same member; this convention is part of the finite contract. Only the interval up to 256 is searched. The verifier uses three distinct members, and it does not claim a sharp asymptotic error term or optimal cardinality.
